final: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as qc_count FROM scanqc WHERE arcref IS NOT NULL GROUP BY arcref), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(qc_count) as total FROM project_counts), with_fractions AS (SELECT pc.arcref, pc.qc_count, CAST(pc.qc_count AS REAL) / tc.total as fraction FROM project_counts pc CROSS JOIN total_count tc WHERE tc.total IS NOT NULL), avg_fraction AS (SELECT AVG(fraction) as avg_frac FROM with_fractions WHERE fraction IS NOT NULL) SELECT wf.arcref, wf.qc_count, wf.fraction, wf.fraction - af.avg_frac as difference FROM with_fractions wf CROSS JOIN avg_fraction af WHERE af.avg_frac IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
